_about: Public-domain Henry Eyster Jacobs (1844-1932), Lutheran theologian at Mount Airy, for the Word Hoard: Elements of Religion (1894), A Summary of the Christian Faith (1905), The Lutheran Movement in England (1890), A History of the Evangelical Lutheran Church in the United States (1893), Martin Luther the Hero of the Reformation (1898) and his Annotations on Romans and 1 Corinthians (1896), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 47 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
